task.title: Enable and prove OpenClaw Responses for dev Management AI

scope.owned_layer: OpenClaw OpenResponses activation, non-empty Management AI stream handling, bounded answer-readiness verification, and dev proof.
not_changing: Source ingestion remains manual-only; no scheduler or connector setting is changed.
Management frontend E2E scope and BFF route ownership are unchanged.
Broker, paper, canary, live, and capital-binding gates remain false and fail closed.

activation_contract.compose_behavior: The openclaw-gateway startup command persists the upstream opt-in before starting the token-authenticated gateway, avoiding healthy-but-404 recreated volumes.
activation_contract.root_deploy_behavior: openclaw-configure-shared-model-pool.sh reconciles and reads back the same true value before its required gateway restart.
activation_contract.adapter_readiness: auth_probe=true is a bounded actual CLI agent answer; URL-only inventory reports not_checked rather than ready.
activation_contract.adapter_stream: The adapter normalizes OpenResponses SSE and returns done only for non-empty assistant text. HTTP 404 maps to OPENCLAW_RESPONSES_DISABLED; empty completion maps to OPENCLAW_RESPONSES_EMPTY.

validation.environment: checkout-scoped .venv-pantheon; no provider credential, source-ingestion write, broker, or capital authority used

hosted_proof.required_result: readiness has a bounded completed answer probe; an adapter OpenResponses SSE turn returns OPENCLAW_LIVE, a non-empty done text, and transport=responses_http without exposing credentials.

review.reviewer_instruction: After hosted proof is recorded and the exact PR head is checked, bind this already-committed manifest with AI_NAME=Antigravity2 REVIEW_FILE=<this path> through the governed approve command.
review.owner_claim: Owner evidence is ready for independent review after the pending hosted probe.
